about: S-4 (the submarine and sea film): the worked example of make_tex.py + make_sprites.py recipes. Field meanings: the header of make_tex.py and make_sprites.py.
note: tile = D covered by one repeat of the texture. Decals multiply: surface * mix(1, rgb, a * instance alpha). What exists right now is what is listed here.

sky_dawn.why: long thin cloud bands do not line up across a cut: it passed the seam check and still showed as a wavy edge

notes.rust_streak: cells 0-5 have their heavy end at the cell top: keep spin near 0 so they run down

sheets.name: sheet_sub_clutter
sheets.prompt: A sprite sheet of six separate objects from inside a 1920s submarine for an old video game, flat cartoon illustration, thick uniform dark brown-black ink outline around every shape, simple two-tone cel shading, muted oily grey-green, rust and dark wood colours, wet and worn, seen from the front at eye level. In a neat 3 by 2 grid with wide empty space between them: a dented steel oil drum, a battered wooden sea chest with rope handles, a steel bucket stuffed with oily rags, a rolled canvas hammock tied with cord, a heap of spare brass valves and big wrenches, a flat coil of thick dark hose. Plain flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF background everywhere. No floor, no ground shadow, nothing touching another object, no people, no faces, no text, no labels, no logos.
